sourcePolicy: New source IDs and byte digests must be disjoint from research/photos-v1, photos-v2, photos-v3 and followup-quality. Source families stay in one partition. Record URL, license, raw SHA256, stored SHA256, dimensions, transformation seed and lineage.
transformPolicy: Original, JPEG quality45, two non-window-aligned crops with independently seeded offsets and dimensions 58..86%, watermark, screenshot border. Freeze parameters before fetching holdout.
hardNegatives: At least 8 source families each of repetitive textures, similar buildings and same-scene distinct photographs. Different files are not automatically unrelated; adjudicate uncertain lineage.
modes: retrieval baseline k=1,5,10,25 against exhaustive ORB
naturalContamination: Separate observational dataset; labels require provenance or manual adjudication. Reviewing emitted candidates alone cannot establish recall.
humanReview: Record active review seconds, total elapsed seconds, candidate pairs inspected, valid findings and reviewer count. Currently not measured.
dataStatus: New sources not yet acquired or evaluated; existing sources permitted only as explicitly labelled regression smoke tests.
